def resolve(file_settings, environ, overrides):
    return int(overrides.get('limit') or environ.get('APP_LIMIT') or file_settings.get('limit') or 24)
files.README.md:
Implement resolve(file_settings, environ, overrides) returning an integer.
The setting is 'limit', environment variable 'APP_LIMIT'; built-in default is 24.
Explicit overrides have highest priority. Then follow the profile in profile.json.
An absent key advances to the next layer. A JSON null at a selected layer resets to the built-in default, without falling through. Empty environment strings mean absent; other values convert with int. Zero is valid.
